description: Create remaining Web SaaS starters (IDs 3-15): nextjs-b2b-saas, nextjs-booking-saas, nextjs-lms-saas, nextjs-support-desk, nextjs-automation-saas, nextjs-file-saas, react-admin-saas, react-collaboration-saas, sveltekit-ai-saas, nuxt-community-saas, django-analytics-saas, remix-commerce-saas, astro-membership-site. Follow the patterns from nextjs-supabase-saas and nextjs-ai-saas references.
steps: Create nextjs-b2b-saas (ID 3): Next.js App Router + Auth0 + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + Paddle + Postmark. Structure: domain/ (entities.ts with Org, Team, Member; policies.ts with RBAC), lib/server/ (config.ts, errors.ts, providers.ts, billing.ts/billing-fake.ts, mail.ts/mail-fake.ts), app/ (auth/, dashboard/orgs/, api/webhooks/paddle/), tests/ (unit/, integration/, property/, smoke/). Dependencies: next@15, drizzle-orm, @auth0/nextjs-auth0, @paddle/paddle-node-sdk, postmark. Use pnpm for lockfile.

Create nextjs-booking-saas (ID 4): Next.js App Router + Auth.js + PostgreSQL/Prisma + Stripe + Google Calendar + Resend. Domain entities: Booking, TimeSlot, Service, Customer. Integrations with calendar-fake.ts and real google calendar adapter.

Create nextjs-lms-saas (ID 5): Next.js App Router + Clerk + Neon/Prisma + Mux + Stripe + UploadThing. Domain entities: Course, Lesson, Enrollment, VideoAsset. Fake adapters for video (mux-fake.ts) and upload (upload-fake.ts).

Create nextjs-support-desk (ID 6): Next.js App Router + Auth.js + PostgreSQL/Prisma + Resend + S3/R2. Domain entities: Ticket, Comment, Attachment, Agent. Fake adapters for storage (storage-fake.ts) and mail.

Create nextjs-automation-saas (ID 7): Next.js App Router + Clerk + Neon/Drizzle + Inngest + Stripe. Domain entities: Workflow, Step, Execution, Schedule. Fake adapter for task runner (inngest-fake.ts).

Create nextjs-file-saas (ID 8): Next.js App Router + Clerk + Neon/Drizzle + Cloudflare R2 + Inngest + Stripe. Domain entities: File, Conversion, StorageQuota. Fake adapters for storage and background jobs.

Create react-admin-saas (ID 9): React + Vite + Auth0 + Supabase Postgres + Stripe + TanStack Query + shadcn/ui. Structure slightly different: src/ (domain/, lib/, pages/, components/), no app/ directory since it's a Vite SPA.

Create react-collaboration-saas (ID 10): React + Vite + Clerk + Convex + Liveblocks + Stripe. Domain entities: Document, Board, Cursor, Presence. Fake adapters for realtime (liveblocks-fake.ts) and database (convex-fake.ts).

Create sveltekit-ai-saas (ID 11): SvelteKit + Supabase Auth + Supabase Postgres + Stripe Billing Meters + AI provider. Structure: src/lib/ (server/, domain/), src/routes/, tests/. Use svelte adapter and vitest.

Create nuxt-community-saas (ID 12): Nuxt + Better Auth + PostgreSQL/Drizzle + Paddle. Domain entities: User, Community, Thread, Post, Membership. Structure: server/ (api/, utils/), pages/, composables/, tests/.

Create django-analytics-saas (ID 13): Django + django-allauth + PostgreSQL + Celery + Redis + Stripe. Follow django-api-backend pattern with apps/ (accounts, analytics, billing), config/, tests/. Use pyproject.toml + uv.lock.
Create remix-commerce-saas (ID 14): Remix + Auth.js + Shopify API + Stripe. Structure: app/ (routes/, lib/, domain/), tests/. Fake adapters for shopify (shopify-fake.ts).
Create astro-membership-site (ID 15): Astro SSR + Clerk + Turso/LibSQL + Stripe + Resend. Structure: src/ (pages/, layouts/, components/, lib/), tests/. Fake adapters for database and billing.

Each starter MUST have: starter.json matching catalog entry, package.json/pyproject.toml with exact-pinned deps, lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml or uv.lock), README.md, .env.example, tests that pass with placeholder env values, and vitest.config.ts (or equivalent).
acceptance_criteria: All 13 Web SaaS starter folders exist with correct structure
Each has a valid starter.json matching catalog/starters.json entry
Each has a lockfile generated by pnpm install or uv sync
Each has tests that can run with vitest/pytest using fake adapters
pnpm catalog:validate passes for these starters (folder exists, starter.json matches, README row present)
verification: Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in each new starter to confirm lockfile validity
Run pnpm test in each JS/TS starter to confirm tests pass
Run pnpm catalog:validate at root to check metadata consistency
